class.name: TrainSpeedControl
class.description: [TrainSpeedControl] wraps the FIZ [code]SpeedControl:[/code] section, configuring the vehicle's cruise control: whether it is present, its response curve, and its optional pneumatic-brake intervention.

members.member: [code]SpeedControl:BrakeIntervention[/code] Whether the cruise control may assist with the automatic pneumatic brake when other means of slowing down are insufficient.
[code]SpeedControl:BrakeIntMaxVel[/code] Maximum velocity, in km/h, at which the cruise control may use pneumatic braking.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrlDelay[/code] Delay before a newly set target velocity is applied.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrlATOF[/code] Bitmask of actions that automatically disengage the cruise control: 1 - moving the main controller lever, 2 - braking.
[code]SpeedControl:MaxPwrVel[/code] Velocity at which the initial power ramp ends and full power engages, in km/h.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrlType[/code] Whether the cruise control lever is impulse-type ([code]Time[/code] in the FIZ file) rather than linear.
[code]SpeedControl:InitPwr[/code] Initial power percentage (0..1) applied before [member full_power_velocity] is reached.
[code]SpeedControl:kIneg[/code] Integral gain applied to a 1 km/h excess in velocity, in km/h/s. Not currently used by the mover - [member integral_gain_positive] is used instead, regardless of sign.
[code]SpeedControl:kIpos[/code] Integral gain applied to a 1 km/h deficit in velocity, in km/h/s.
[code]SpeedControl:MaxPwr[/code] Maximum power the cruise control may request, in the range 0..1.
[code]SpeedControl:MaxVel[/code] Maximum settable target velocity, in km/h.
[code]SpeedControl:MinPwr[/code] Minimum power the cruise control may request, in the range 0..1.
[code]SpeedControl:MinVel[/code] Minimum settable target velocity, in km/h.
[code]SpeedControl:Offset[/code] Target velocity control error offset, in km/h.
[code]SpeedControl:OverrideManual[/code] Whether the cruise control overrides manual power settings.
[code]SpeedControl:PowerDownSpeed[/code] Rate at which requested power decreases, in 100%/s.
[code]SpeedControl:PwrStep[/code] Step size (0..1) for the +/- power adjustment buttons.
[code]SpeedControl:PowerUpSpeed[/code] Rate at which requested power increases, in 100%/s.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedButtons[/code] Predefined target velocities (up to 10 values, in km/h) selectable with number key shortcuts.
[code]SpeedControl:kPneg[/code] Braking power proportional gain for a 1 km/h excess in velocity.
[code]SpeedControl:kPpos[/code] Drive power proportional gain for a 1 km/h deficit in velocity.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrl[/code] Whether the vehicle is equipped with cruise control.
[code]SpeedControl:StartVel[/code] Velocity, in km/h, up to which the vehicle must confirm it has actually started moving (main controller at its last position).
[code]SpeedControl:VelStep[/code] Step size, in km/h, for the +/- velocity adjustment buttons.
